messages:
Alex: 🚨 Heads-up team — we just hit $50M ARR today. yes, really. :tada: :confetti_ball:
Rina: WHAT. holy moly. massive congrats to everyone — sales, infra, product, ops, and of course support. :heart:
Carlos: that number is unreal. can we get a rooftop kazoo parade or is that too extra? :kazoo:
Tess: I vote boba truck + stickers. also a tiny video montage? quick 3-min montage for the company call would be cute.
Jordan: Poll: :boba: boba truck, :cake: cake, :sticker: stickers only, :coffee: coffee cart
Sam: :boba:
Rina: :sticker:
Alex: :boba: + :sticker: (do both pls)
Carlos: shoutout to the tiny infra team who squeezed latency down last month. you all rock. :muscle:
Tess: metrics nugget for #metrics — feel free to copy:
```
arr_usd=50000000
monthly_active_customers=312
qtr_arr_growth=1.9x
median_latency_ms=36
```
Jordan: median_latency 36ms!!! passing round of silent applause. :clap:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: All-hands celebratory toast @ 2026-04-02 15:00 PT in #all-hands (automated)
Alex: planning: in-office boba & stickers Friday 4/9, remote folks get care package + digital sticker pack. ops gang, can you coordinate vendor and shipping? tagging @ops and @people-ops
Sam: I'll start a sign-up sheet for dietary prefs. also assembling a tiny thanks note to include in care packages.
Rina: can someone make a goofy banner image? I can animate a kazoo wave if we want silly.
Carlos: OK i'm on kazoo banner GIF duty. handing off to Tess for montage edits.
Tess: montage will be 90s ad vibes. because why not. :boom:
Alex: love it. this is a small victory lap but big momentum — thank you all. 
Rina: confetti and gratitude! :sparkles:
